properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for validating review of audit reports like SOC 2 Type 2
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to verify if audit reports such as SOC 2 Type II Reports have been reviewed. Cloud Service Provider store, maintain, and manage encryption keys securely and appropriately, including the rotation of encryption keys on a periodic basis according to their Cryptographic Control Standard Operating Procedure (SOP). This is verified by internal and external auditors, and it is <CUSTOMER> responsibility for reviewing audit reports such as SOC 2 Type II Reports.
